title: Tremolo (example)
description: The volume rises and falls. The example firmware: turn PARA to pick rate, depth, shape or preset, click to adjust, hold to save; the foot switch turns it on and off.

title: Dreamcatcher
description: Ambient looper, glitch delay with grains and pitch shifting, and reverb, free or in time with a tempo. 8 presets. Source: github.com/OpenGP5/Dreamcatcher.
